summary: P0 multi-country payroll engine refactor backend regression: 22/22 tests PASSED. Verified that payroll.py now sources rates dynamically via get_company_rates_flat() instead of hardcoded DR constants. DR rates (3.04/2.87/7.09/7.10/1/1) and CO rates (4/4/8.5/12/0.522/4) are applied correctly across add-employees, calculate, PUT entry, and POST/DELETE novelty endpoints. ISR uses legacy DGII for DO and bracket-based dynamic for other countries. Country catalog returns 28 countries grouped in 5 regions. Company test_refactor@fortexa.com is restored to DO/DOP at end of the run.
critical_code_review_comments: payroll.py imports look clean: legacy DR constants (PAYROLL_TYPES, ISR_OBREROS_RATE, calculate_isr_monthly) preserved as fallback for OBREROS_NG and DR ISR; multi-country rates fetched per request via get_company_rates_flat()
_compute_isr() helper correctly branches: DR -> calculate_isr_monthly (legacy DGII interpolation table), other countries -> calculate_isr_dynamic (bracket-based)
All 5 hot paths use dynamic rates: add-employees (line 234), update_payroll_entry (line 426), add_novelty (line 642), delete_novelty (line 728), calculate_period (line 803)
get_company_rates_flat() fallback default is DO when company has no country - safe for legacy companies
country_config.py is 1120 lines (mostly data tables for 28 country profiles) - acceptable; consider splitting profiles to JSON in future for editability
seed_data_creation: Test creates a temporary payroll period (TEST_multicountry_regression, mensual REG 2026-06) with all active employees added, runs all multi-country recalcs against it, then deletes it. Company country is restored to DO at the end via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 dynamic rates engine validated end-to-end. test_multi_country_payroll.py is reusable as regression suite for any future refactor. Final state: company test_refactor@fortexa.com.country='DO', currency='DOP'. No leftover test periods. The PUT /api/payroll/entries/{id} endpoint requires the FULL PayrollEntryCreate payload (period_id + employee_id + base_salary + overtime_*_hours + bonuses + commissions + other_income + additional_deductions); a partial body returns 422.

country_switching: PUT switch back to DO updates currency to DOP
multi_country_engine: POST /api/payroll/periods/{id}/add-employees uses DR rates when country=DO (3.04/2.87/7.09/7.10/1/1)
POST /api/payroll/periods/{id}/calculate switches entries to CO rates after country switch (4/4/8.5/12/0.522/4)
Switching back to DO + recalculate restores DR rates exactly
ISR for DR uses calculate_isr_monthly (legacy DGII) - 0 for gross < ~34k DOP
ISR for CO uses calculate_isr_dynamic (brackets) - 0 for gross < ~52M COP
PUT /api/payroll/entries/{id} recomputes with current country rates (verified CO)
POST /api/payroll/entries/{id}/novelties recomputes with current country rates (verified CO)
Final state: company country restored to DO

rca of the issue: N/A - no defects found. Refactor is correct and regression-safe.
